name: clockoff
description: Gym priorities, member and class evidence, and guided campaign drafts through the ClockOff MCP.

interface.longDescription: Use ClockOff in conversation for dated gym priorities, member journeys, unsent follow-up drafts and reviewed campaign planning. Native choices and image forms depend on host capabilities. An optional workspace and creative gallery complement chat. Booking coverage is partial. Saving a campaign does not publish it or spend money.
capabilities: View collected current and past gym ads
Explore observed class bookings by time
defaultPrompt: Start ClockOff. If current gym data supports a useful priority, tell me one; then offer three things I can do here.
Who needs a personal welcome or first-class follow-up today?
